roleKicker: Full-stack Software Engineer // Engineering Lead // Technical Writer
aboutMe: I’m Divine Orji, a full-stack software engineer and Head of Engineering at The Kreativ Studio, where I lead a remote team and stay hands-on with frontend, backend, and deployment work.

Work at The Kreativ Studio includes Bonjour Quick Bites, an online ordering storefront, and Noma, a nursing exam prep app. I also write technical guides and created the curriculum behind Alchemy Of Code to help learners turn ideas into working software.
speakerBio: Divine Orji is a full-stack software engineer, technical writer, and Head of Engineering at The Kreativ Studio, where he leads a remote team and builds web products such as Bonjour Quick Bites and Noma. He writes hands-on guides for freeCodeCamp and created the software engineering curriculum behind Alchemy Of Code. At Innovation Growth Hub in Aba, he trained and mentored more than 100 web development students. His work focuses on building useful software and helping others learn to build their own.

projects.title: Crunchies Online
description: Crunchies Fried Chicken hired me to redesign its online ordering site over seven months. The redesign focused on checkout, especially how customers choose delivery or pickup and find the right outlet.

projects.title: Bonjour Quick Bites
description: An online storefront for ordering fresh bread, pastries, hot meals, and celebration cakes in Port Harcourt, with outlet pickup or doorstep delivery.
I built the platform end to end with Next.js and TypeScript, using Supabase for the database and Better Auth for authentication. I used Git for version control and GitHub and Vercel for CI/CD.
I looked to Mobbin for design inspiration and used its MCP server alongside the Vercel and GitHub MCP servers during development.

projects.title: The Iroko Circle
description: The Iroko Circle brings readers and writers together around African literature. Its website publishes new writing and gives visitors ways to submit work, join a chapter, and sign up for the newsletter.

projects.title: Noma
description: Noma helps nurses prepare for their exams with flashcards for reviewing key concepts and quizzes for testing what they know.

projects.title: Merphils
description: Merphils is a school management platform in development. The goal is to give staff tools for daily operations and let families and students access academic records without juggling separate accounts.

projects.title: Grooovy
description: Grooovy is an event platform in development for finding nights out you might otherwise hear about through friends or group chats. It brings public event listings, ticketing, and host tools together.

projects.title: Alchemy Of Code
description: Alchemy Of Code is a learning platform based on my curriculum. It helps learners master software engineering fundamentals and become well-rounded builders who can take an idea from concept to working software.
The platform runs on Cloudflare, with Supabase for its database and Better Auth for authentication.
